flashcards.front: What is Perimeter?
flashcards.back: The total boundary length surrounding a 2D closed figure.
flashcards.explanation_or_tip:
Sum of all outer side lengths.

📖 Lexicographical Guide: Perimeter (/puh-rim-i-ter/): Total distance around the outer boundary of 2D shape.

💡 Memory Trigger: Perimeter is the Rim or Fence length around the boundary!
